## Summary

The Reel recommends Eugene Yan's `applied-ml` GitHub repository. It is a curated collection of papers, articles, and posts describing how organizations apply data science and machine learning in production.

The collection lets readers study both the use cases and implementation approaches used by companies such as Uber, Google, and DoorDash. The Reel demonstrates the forecasting section and emphasizes that the resources are free to access.
